en.headline: Hung Hom drone show goes ahead after weather delay
en.dek: The first of two National Day drone flights at the Hung Hom promenade was cancelled; the second display went ahead.
body: A National Day drone display went ahead on Friday night at the Hung Hom waterfront after the first of two planned flights was cancelled because of the weather, RTHK reported.
The second show proceeded over the new Hung Hom promenade and drew residents and visitors. Drones formed patterns over the harbour, including hearts and a high-speed train, the station said.

Organisers had scheduled two flights on Friday evening as part of National Day programmes, alongside a variety show at the Hong Kong Coliseum. RTHK said the opening flight was called off in response to the weather, while the later flight was held.
Showers and thunderstorms affected parts of Hong Kong through Friday afternoon and evening. The amber rainstorm warning had already been cancelled by 7:30pm.

zh.headline: 紅磡無人機匯演次場照演　首場因天氣取消
zh.dek: 國慶無人機表演原定紅磡新海濱兩場，港台報道首場因天氣取消，第二場順利舉行。
body: 港台報道，國慶無人機表演周五晚在紅磡新海濱舉行。原定兩場之中，首場因天氣取消，第二場則順利進行，吸引市民和旅客觀賞。
無人機在海面上組成不同圖案和字樣，包括心形和高鐵。表演在紅磡新海濱上空進行。
籌辦方面早前公布，周五晚上會在紅磡新海濱安排兩場無人機匯演，並在紅磡香港體育館舉行國慶文藝晚會。港台說，現場因應天氣取消首場，第二場則照常演出。
本港周五下午至晚間部分地區有驟雨及雷暴。黃色暴雨警告已於晚上7時30分取消。
